Package gamerules

Interface EvaluationFunction

All Superinterfaces:
java.util.function.BiFunction<GameState,​Player,​java.lang.Double>
All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleGoalDistance
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface
public interface EvaluationFunction
extends java.util.function.BiFunction<GameState,​Player,​java.lang.Double>
It is best for the integrity of the rest of the program, if the implementor of this interface tries to avoid using methods from GameState that requires GameState.dummy_board to be altered. (for example, use the GameState.getIntegerRepresentation() instead)
